summary: ING Groep N.V. filed a Form 6-K reporting that its Polish subsidiary, ING Bank Śląski, completed the acquisition of the remaining 55% stake in Goldman Sachs TFI, a Polish asset manager, for PLN 405 million (approx. €95 million). The deal was announced Nov 18, 2025. ING already held 45% since 2019. Goldman Sachs TFI has ~778k clients and PLN 56bn in AUM, holding #2 market share (12% of capital market mutual funds). The transaction will reduce ING Bank Śląski's consolidated total capital ratio and Tier 1 ratio by ~32 bps, with minimal impact on group CET1. The acquired entity will be renamed ING TFI. Watch for integration and potential market share consolidation in Poland.
